contract.scope: Loopback TCP, one authoritative escort session, server physics and real combat model. No shipped multiplayer client, account/authentication, WAN/TLS, reconnect, persistence, load capacity, production-engine or MMO readiness claim.

observation_limits: Actual packet/physics schedules vary. Recorded samples are not exact golden traces, independent players, a latency benchmark or a capacity estimate.
